verdict.rationale: A direct probe shows Increase serves a machine-readable OpenAPI document at https://increase.com/openapi.json. It returned HTTP 200 and contains the "openapi" key, so the spec is publicly downloadable. missing for 10: first-party documentation pointing users to the spec, and evidence of the spec's completeness or versioning across the API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://increase.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
